name: GMDS MISF Geodesic-Isometry Manifest
purpose: Replace cMDS-based GMDS initialization on difficult graph families with a MISF-based coarse-to-fine geodesic-isometry pipeline that reuses GRIP's MISF scaffold while keeping pure GMDS as the numerical core objective.

summary: Recent paraboloid experiments indicate that pure GMDS can recover the smooth surface when started in the right basin.
The dominant practical failure mode on regular orthogonal meshes is poor basin selection from cMDS, not absence of a smooth GMDS solution.
MISF is the most promising next intervention because it provides a multiscale coarse-to-fine scaffold that can replace the global spectral initializer.
references: ./references/literature/graph_drawing/A Fast Multi-Dimensional Algorithm for Drawing Large Graphs.pdf

included: MISF extraction from existing GRIP internals
A new graph-first MISF-GMDS prepared-object layer
A top-level pure-GMDS solve on the coarsest MISF level
Geodesic-aware insertion of successive MISF levels
Sparse local GMDS refinement on each active MISF level
excluded_initially: Rewriting the existing DrawGraph::mish_engine() into a GMDS engine
Changing the default behavior of grip.optimize.geodesic.mds()
Broader cross-family benchmarks before the paraboloid story is coherent
Using cMDS as the default initializer for the new MISF pipeline

new_functions.name: grip.build.misf
new_functions.purpose: Expose the MISF structure of an arbitrary weighted graph.

new_functions.name: grip.prepare.misf.geodesic.mds
new_functions.purpose: Build the MISF-aware prepared object used by the multiscale GMDS solver.

new_functions.name: grip.optimize.misf.geodesic.mds
new_functions.purpose: Run the full MISF-based coarse-to-fine GMDS optimization.

new_functions.name: grip.score.misf.geodesic.mds
new_functions.purpose: Score and summarize the final MISF-GMDS result and optional per-level trace.

deferred_integration.name: init = 'misf' in grip.optimize.geodesic.mds
deferred_integration.purpose: Add the multiscale initializer to the existing pure GMDS API only after the sibling pathway is stable.

high_level_steps: Build the MIS filtration V = V_0 ⊃ V_1 ⊃ ... ⊃ V_k from the weighted graph.
Solve pure GMDS on the induced top-level graph over V_k.
Insert vertices of V_i \ V_{i+1} using weighted geodesic anchor trilateration against already placed coarse anchors.
After each level insertion, refine the active set V_i with a sparse pure-GMDS objective using local neighbors plus landmarks.
After reaching V_0, run a short global pure-GMDS polish.
algorithm_definition.insertion_objective: P_t(z) = sum_{a in A_t} w_ta * (||z - z_a|| - d_G(t,a))^2

phases.title: MISF extraction layer
phases.goal: Expose GRIP's MISF structure in a graph-first reusable form.

phases.title: Prepared object and top-level coarse GMDS solve
phases.goal: Replace cMDS/random top-level initialization by a pure GMDS solve on the coarsest MISF level.
verification: Lower top-level energy than random placement
Prepared object contains MISF and induced coarse-graph metadata

phases.title: Geodesic insertion of new MISF levels
phases.goal: Insert successive levels using weighted geodesic anchor distances rather than GRIP's Euclidean graph-drawing insertion.
verification: Exact or near-exact recovery on tiny realizable examples
Stable insertion on regular and irregular paraboloids
Deterministic anchor selection under fixed seeds

phases.title: Sparse local GMDS refinement
phases.goal: Refine each active MISF level using sparse pure GMDS instead of local KK or FR.
verification: Numeric agreement with dense or R reference on small cases

phases.title: High-level API and trace output
phases.goal: Expose MISF-GMDS as a clean experimental algorithm with per-level trace support.
verification: MISF-GMDS runs from graph-first prepared objects without cMDS

phases.title: Paraboloid-first validation slice
phases.goal: Verify that MISF-GMDS improves basin selection on the graph families that motivated the work.
verification: Direct comparison against cmdscale -> GMDS baseline
Metrics sigma, rho, eta, alpha_0.05, runtime

risks.title: MISF extraction does not expose enough internal structure
risks.mitigation: Prefer surfacing read-only accessors from DrawGraph before reimplementing MISF elsewhere.

risks.title: Top-level coarse GMDS remains unstable
risks.mitigation: Use multiple restarts and keep a tiny anchor-to-best-restart diagnostic path available.

risks.title: Sparse levelwise GMDS is too slow
risks.mitigation: Use local-neighbor plus landmark sparse pairs and keep pair budgets explicit.

risks.title: MISF improves basin selection but not enough on regular grids
risks.mitigation: Benchmark regular and irregular paraboloids side by side before broadening to other families.
